title: Galaxy
tagline: A procedural galaxy you can fall into — star by star, world by world.
description: Generate a spiral galaxy from a seed, then fall from the disc to a star system and down to a single world. Planets, moons, rings and asteroid belts are generated, never stored; every one has a full dossier — radius, mass, gravity, atmosphere, biosphere, moons — and every URL is a place you can share.
